title: Two paragraphs in one story
concept: Each paragraph is its own ParagraphStyleRange; the count of those blocks is the paragraph count.

annotations.note: The first paragraph: one ParagraphStyleRange wrapping one CharacterStyleRange and its Content.
The second paragraph: a sibling ParagraphStyleRange. A new paragraph means a new range, not a break inside the first.
SpaceBefore="6" is a local override on this range — space added above the paragraph, in points.
